name: Route
description: Route/: ImagingRoute (CPU or GPU for a list of tone steps, CPU whenever a step is not on Metal yet) and, on macOS, LiveToneSurface, which keeps the base resident on the GPU and folds each step's tone program into the display encode. suite-imaging IM-2 declares them as stubs; IM-4 and IM-5 fill the bodies.
technology: Swift 6, Foundation (FoundationEssentials), CoreRender and CoreRaster; CoreRenderMetal and Metal on macOS
